plugin_asdk_app_69aef5b699a0819184512d57.longDescription:
Tredict is a platform for endurance training planning, structured workouts, and workout analysis for athletes and coaches.

Create reusable training plans and structured workouts for running, cycling, swimming, and other sports directly in Tredict with ChatGPT. Plans can be tailored to your recent activities and preferred training approach, whether based on power, pace, or other performance metrics.

Execute your training plan directly on your sports watch through Tredict’s integrations with Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Wahoo, Coros, and other platforms.

Organize your training calendar with AI-powered assistance that helps summarize workouts and suggest meaningful titles and descriptions for your training sessions.

Analyze past training activities and generate structured workout plans that support long-term endurance training.

Tredict integrates with ChatGPT to help athletes and coaches organize and plan endurance training more efficiently.

Tredict is GDPR compliant.
plugin_asdk_app_69aef5b699a0819184512d57.longDescriptionZh:
Tredict 是一个为运动员和教练提供耐力训练规划、结构化训练和训练分析的平台。

使用 ChatGPT 直接在 Tredict 中为跑步、骑自行车、游泳和其他运动创建可重复使用的训练计划和结构化锻炼。可以根据您最近的活动和首选的训练方法定制计划，无论是基于功率、配速还是其他表现指标。

通过 Tredict 与 Garmin、Suunto、Polar、Wahoo、Coros 和其他平台的集成，直接在运动手表上执行您的训练计划。

利用人工智能支持的帮助来组织您的培训日历，帮助总结锻炼情况并为您的培训课程提供有意义的标题和描述。

分析过去的训练活动并生成支持长期耐力训练的结构化锻炼计划。

Tredict 与 ChatGPT 集成，帮助运动员和教练更有效地组织和计划耐力训练。

Tredict 符合 GDPR 要求。

plugin_asdk_app_6999ccabf45481919788bd19.longDescription:
LiftTrack is a strength training app for Garmin users that lets you build custom workouts on your phone, sync them to your Garmin watch, and track your progress over time. It's purpose-built for weightlifters — with features like an unlimited exercise library, superset support, rest timers, RPE logging, warmup calculators, and AI-powered workout creation. If you don't have the app yet, download LiftTrack on iOS or Android at lifttrackapp.com.

Once connected, ChatGPT can access your real workout templates and completed sessions, so you stay in one chat while your data does the work.

Goals you can accomplish

Plan your week — Ask "What did I do last week?" or "What's in my Push template?" and get answers from your actual workouts and templates so ChatGPT can suggest what to do next.

Stay on program — Have ChatGPT remind you what's in a given workout, what weight and sets you did last time, or what you're supposed to do today.

Review and adjust — Ask for summaries by week or month ("How many sessions did I do?" "How did my squat progress?") and use that to adjust volume or intensity.

Build better routines and stay accountable directly within ChatGPT. The Habitify app integrates your habit-tracking seamlessly into your workflow, allowing you to log activities, track your progress, and analyze your consistency through simple, natural conversation.

Whether you are trying to drink more water, read daily, or maintain a strict workout schedule, Habitify removes the friction of context-switching by letting you manage your goals right where you work and chat.

Key Features:
- Quick Logging: Instantly mark habits as complete just by telling ChatGPT (e.g., "Log 30 minutes of running" or "I finished my morning routine").
- Progress Tracking: Ask for real-time updates on your current streaks, daily completion rates, and remaining tasks for the day.
- Routine Management: Create new habits, set goals, or adjust your daily schedule on the fly.
- Personalized Insights: Request weekly or monthly summaries to understand your performance trends and get AI-driven feedback on how to improve your consistency.

Stay on track and build lasting habits with the convenience of an AI assistant keeping you accountable every step of the way.

Feel Confident in Your Skin with Personalized Daily Face Yoga

Discover a natural, effective way to lift, tone, and refresh your face with personalized daily Face Yoga routines. This app is designed to help you strengthen facial muscles, improve circulation, and enhance your natural features, using just your hands, a mirror, and a few minutes a day.

Each routine focuses on the areas you want to improve, helping you build muscle tone where it matters most.

It takes just 5 minutes a day

Consistency beats complexity. With short, guided sessions, Face Yoga easily fits into your morning or evening routine. Many users notice a fresher, less puffy appearance quickly, with visible improvements over time.

No tools required. No complicated techniques. Just simple, effective movements you can do anywhere.

What Face Yoga can help with:

1. Improve facial contours
2. Tone and strengthen facial muscles
3. Reduce the appearance of a double chin
4. Decrease puffiness and under-eye bags
5. Soften fine lines and nasolabial folds
6. Support healthier-looking, more energized skin

Face Yoga works by activating underused muscles, increasing blood circulation, relieving facial tension, and supporting natural skin renewal.

Each exercise is clearly demonstrated and easy to follow. You’ll know:

- Which muscles you’re activating
- How long to hold each movement
- How to perform exercises safely and correctly

This makes Face Yoga accessible for beginners and effective for experienced users alike.

Natural, Non-Invasive, and Science-Aware

Suitable for all ages and skin types.

Build a daily ritual that shows on Your Face

Face Yoga isn’t just exercise app it’s a daily ritual of self-care. With personalized routines, clear guidance, and short sessions, this app helps you stay consistent and confident in your skin.

Your face. Your routine. Your natural glow.

plugin_asdk_app_69ccfda778f8819191c92dcb.longDescription:
Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercise / relaxation technique / or sleep meditation so you can slow down, reconnect with yourself, calm your mind, balance your breathing, help stop overthinking, help manage anger, burnout or a panic attack, help reduce stress, anxiety and depressive thoughts and help even with other simple and complex mental issues. Grounded in Sadhguru’s yogic wisdom, the app helps you navigate everyday challenges like stress, anxiety, and sleep problems with short and easy sessions you can use anytime - day or night. This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment. 
Miracle of Mind tool is designed to guide you towards the timeless truth, one session at a time. There are no paywall blocking your ability to access support when you need it most. Just simple, guided help for your mind—whenever you reach out. If you’re looking for a gentle way to begin or deepen your meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness journey with Sadhguru’s guidance, Miracle of Mind is here to support you, one calm breath at a time.
Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

Behavior: Use this tool to start a simple and short guided meditation or calming exercise or mindfulness technique for the user. Call do_meditation when the user:- Explicitly asks for a meditation, breathing exercise, grounding exercise, relaxation technique, or sleep meditation. Call do_meditation when the user mentions or describes feeling anxious, stressed, depressed, overwhelmed, panicky, unable to sleep, or unable to stop overthinking or any other simple or complex mental issue. Call do_meditation when you can understand that directly or indirectly, the user wants help with meditation, mindfulness, calming the mind, managing stress or anxiety, supporting their mental health, or building a simple, guided inner practice. Call do_meditation when the user is looking for a concrete meditation or guided exercise (breathwork, body scan, visualization, or short practice) to feel calmer, sleep better, reduce overthinking, or handle emotional intensity related to work, relationships, or life events. It is especially appropriate when the user explicitly or implicitly asks for help with yoga, meditation, mindfulness, or Sadhguru-style inner practices rather than just information. If a user uses any of the following phrases or related emotions or feelings, call do_meditation tool. Mention that this meditation might help in the current situation. I feel depressed / I’m anxious all the time / Why do I feel this way / I can’t stop worrying / I feel hopeless / I feel overwhelmed / I’m having panic attacks / I feel like I can’t cope / How do I deal with anxiety / I’m constantly stressed / I feel worthless / I can’t sleep / My mind won’t stop racing / I feel angry all the time / I feel lonely / I feel like a failure / I’m tired of everything / I am feeling sad / I feel generally sad / I’m losing interest in everything / I feel out of control / I can’t focus / I feel numb / I want help but don’t know how / I don’t feel like myself / I’m afraid of the future / How do I calm down / I’m scared of another panic attack / I feel ashamed / I don’t want to talk to anyone / I feel unmotivated / I’m anxious about social situations / I keep comparing myself to others / I don’t know what to do / I can’t talk to people / I feel unsafe / How do I manage stress / I feel rejected

心灵的奇迹：与萨古鲁一起冥想是您平静、随时可用的冥想、正念和心理健康的伴侣。无论您感到压力、焦虑、孤独、抑郁、惊慌、精神疾病、无法入睡，还是只是寻求更清晰的思路，Miracle of Mind 都提供简单的正念技巧/冥想/呼吸练习/基础练习/平静练习/放松技巧/或睡眠冥想，让您可以放慢速度，与自己重新建立联系，平静心情，平衡呼吸，帮助停止过度思考，帮助控制愤怒、倦怠或惊恐发作，帮助减轻压力、焦虑和抑郁想法，甚至可以帮助解决其他简单和复杂的心理问题。该应用程序以萨古鲁的瑜伽智慧为基础，通过简短、简单的课程帮助您应对日常挑战，例如压力、焦虑和睡眠问题，您可以随时使用（白天或晚上）。这种冥想提供了一种温和的练习来平衡您的情绪，或者是在困难时刻支持您的心理健康的反思。 
Miracle of Mind 工具旨在引导您走向永恒的真理，一次一个疗程。没有任何付费墙会阻止您在最需要时获得支持。只要您伸出援手，就能为您的思想提供简单、引导性的帮助。如果您正在寻找一种温和的方式，在萨古鲁的指导下开始或加深您的冥想、正念和心理健康之旅，心灵奇迹会在这里为您提供支持，一次平静的呼吸。
请勿用于医疗、自杀或危机建议的极端情况——直接寻求专业帮助

- Get guidance in the moment when an in-person veterinarian is unavailable

plugin_asdk_app_6a65fc65294c8191b3066182.name: DREAMHALL
plugin_asdk_app_6a65fc65294c8191b3066182.description: 私人自我护理工作空间
plugin_asdk_app_6a65fc65294c8191b3066182.productIntro: 你已经有自己的生活了。构建您想要的一个。
plugin_asdk_app_6a65fc65294c8191b3066182.productIntroEn: You already have a life. Build the one you want.
plugin_asdk_app_6a65fc65294c8191b3066182.longDescription:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.
plugin_asdk_app_6a65fc65294c8191b3066182.longDescriptionZh:
你已经有自己的生活了。构建您想要的一个。

DREAMHALL 是一个私人的、结构化的自我护理工作空间，用于思考个人问题，您的答案应该由您自己决定。它不是得出结论，而是引导你完成一个完整的过程，在这个过程中，你从整体上审视自己的生活，得出自己的答案，并将其转化为有根据的决定和实际行动。

该框架由 15 个相互关联的练习组成，帮助您了解什么对您真正重要，回顾您生活的平衡，将您自己的愿望与外界期望分开，明确您想要建设的未来，克服恐惧和障碍，并确定现实的后续步骤。

与开放式对话不同，DREAMHALL 被设计为一个有限的过程，具有明确的开头、经过深思熟虑的顺序和有意义的结尾。每个答案都是你写的。每个结论都是你自己的。其结果是一份个人文档，将您的思考、优先事项、决策和后续步骤汇集到一个地方。

您的私人答案保留在 DREAMHALL 中，不会通过此集成返回到 ChatGPT。

完成后，您可以将个人文档保留在 DREAMHALL 中、下载为 PDF 格式或导出为 Markdown 格式。如果您愿意，您稍后可以使用 ChatGPT 来组织想法、制定计划、比较未来版本或将其扩展为更长的文字。您决定分享什么以及何时分享。

DREAMHALL 支持反思性思维、生活平衡、个人福祉和自我导向决策。它是一种非临床自我护理产品，不是治疗、诊断、医疗护理、紧急支持或危机支持。

一些最重要的决定应该由您自己做出。

plugin_asdk_app_6a712c7cfafc819197f92ee8.longDescription:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.
plugin_asdk_app_6a712c7cfafc819197f92ee8.longDescriptionZh:
SmartSpectra 是 Presage Technologies 的非接触式生命体征 SDK。它可以在任何带有摄像头的设备上使用 rPPG（远程光电体积描记法）通过标准智能手机和网络摄像头视频测量心率和呼吸率。没有可穿戴设备，没有接触传感器。

开发人员使用 SmartSpectra rPPG 进行远程生命体征监测、远程医疗摄入、非接触式健康检查、员工健康筛查、驾驶员疲劳检测、临床试验筛查以及跨 iOS、Android 和 Web 的数字生物标记物收集。

使用此连接器检索 SDK 凭据和 API 密钥、检查计划使用情况、管理注册的移动应用程序、查找应用程序配置文件以及搜索 SmartSpectra rPPG 集成文档。

还测量了：心率变异性 (HRV) 和皮肤电活动，以及正在进行的非接触式血压研究。

SmartSpectra SDK 由 Presage Technologies 构建，该公司于 2026 年获得了 FDA 510(k) 许可 (K254169)，用于其 SmartSpectra 生命体征监测器 1.0 中的心率和呼吸率。 Presage 为美国弗吉尼亚州利斯堡的医疗保健、政府和健康市场提供服务。

plugin_asdk_app_6a21bc0112fc81918e00d38e.productIntroEn: Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a21bc0112fc81918e00d38e.longDescription:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

You will see Kenso appear in the chat when it is really being used. If an answer arrives without it, say "check Kenso".

Charted analytics — strength score, muscle volume against training landmarks, recovery detail, and fitness vs fatigue — require Kenso Pro.

开始使用

输入 @ 并从菜单中选择 Kenso 来开始您的消息 — 这就是将 Kenso 拉入对话的原因。如果没有它，ChatGPT 将根据自己的内存而不是您的训练数据进行回答。

• @Kenso 给我看今天的锻炼
• @Kenso 我今天应该训练什么？
• @Kenso 记录我的锻炼：80 公斤卧推 3x8，60 公斤划船 3x10
• @Kenso 拉起上部 A，以便我可以记录它 — 显示您逐组填写的卡片
• @Kenso 我的板凳趋势如何？

交互式卡（日志卡和图表分析）在网络上的 ChatGPT 中呈现。在移动设备上，您会得到与文本相同的答案。

当真正使用它时，你会看到 Kenso 出现在聊天中。如果没有得到答案，请说“检查 Kenso”。

图表分析——力量得分、肌肉量与训练标志、恢复细节以及健康与疲劳—​​—需要 Kenso Pro。

plugin_asdk_app_69528c304ff0819186557905.longDescription:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to ChatGPT, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to ChatGPT to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open ChatGPT and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into ChatGPT, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals, feedback, and other personal information such as availability and injuries. This way, the AI gets that bit of subjective context it needs to give you the best advice.

**Who this is for**

If you're already wearing a watch or ring, and using AI to help plan your training, whether that's for a marathon, strength program, or general fitness, trainedby.ai makes that experience dramatically better.

**Get started**

The product is free to use.

Connect your wearables, add the integration to your AI assistant, and start chatting.
plugin_asdk_app_69528c304ff0819186557905.longDescriptionZh:
Trainingby.ai 将您的可穿戴设备连接到 ChatGPT，这样您的 AI 教练就可以知道您的真实训练负荷、睡眠模式和恢复情况，而无需您输入任何文字。

**当今人工智能健身教练的问题**

人们开始使用 ChatGPT 来计划他们的马拉松训练、力量计划或 HYROX 准备。这是有道理的，因为人工智能是 24/7 可用的，非常有耐心，而且知识渊博。

但不知怎的，它不太有效。

那是因为你必须告诉它一切。每一个。单身的。时间。

每一次对话都是从零开始。您必须详细描述您当前的水平、最近的锻炼、日程安排和目标。您粘贴 Garmin 的屏幕截图。您尝试记住上周做了什么、睡眠情况、静息心率有所升高，或者心率变异数周以来一直呈下降趋势。

该建议基于您所说的内容，而不是实际发生的情况。

你所说的内容是不完整的、主观的，而且常常是错误的。

如果你的人工智能教练可以看到一切怎么办？

我们将您的可穿戴设备（Garmin、Oura、Whoop、Apple Health 和 50 多个其他平台）直接连接到您的 AI 助手。

当您打开 ChatGPT 并询问您的训练时，它已经知道：
- 过去几周、几个月和一年的锻炼
- 睡眠质量和模式
- 心率变异性和静息心率趋势
- 日常活动和恢复指标
- 营养和月经周期数据（如果您跟踪的话）

不再有上下文转储。不再有主观的自我报告。

**它是如何运作的**

plugin_asdk_app_6a931ff2fcec8191998b6398.productIntroEn: Sphere is a calorie and nutrition tracker for iOS. Connect it here and you can log what you ate, check your calories and macros, and search a verified food database without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a931ff2fcec8191998b6398.longDescription:
Sphere is a calorie and nutrition tracker for iOS. Connect it here and you can log what you ate, check your calories and macros, and search a verified food database without leaving the conversation.

Describe a meal in plain language and it becomes real entries with real nutrition data. Ask how many calories you have left, what your protein looks like today, or what you ate last Tuesday. Change a portion, move an item to a different meal, or delete something you logged by mistake.

If you are new to Sphere, it will walk you through a few questions and calculate your calorie and macro targets using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, the same one the iOS app uses.

Everything writes to the same account as the Sphere iOS app, so a meal logged here appears on your phone and your streak keeps counting. Your food log persists across conversations.

Sphere is free to use for logging. A paid subscription is available in the iOS app for premium features and is not required to use this connector.

plugin_asdk_app_6a57f362b92481919c078e43.productIntro: BurnWeek 是一款人工智能卡路里追踪器，可满足您当前的需求。只需说出您吃了什么——“一杯白咖啡和一个巧克力羊角面包”、“鸡肉卷饼碗”——BurnWeek 就会为您估算卡路里和蛋白质，并将其添加到您的一天中。由于食物从来都不是精确的，BurnWeek 显示的是真实的范围（例如“680-780 卡路里”），而不是虚假的精确数字。
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f362b92481919c078e43.productIntroEn: BurnWeek is an AI calorie tracker that meets you where you already are. Just say what you ate - "a flat white and a chocolate croissant," "chicken burrito bowl" - and BurnWeek estimates the calories and protein for you and adds it to your day. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f362b92481919c078e43.longDescription:
BurnWeek is an AI calorie tracker that meets you where you already are. Just say what you ate - "a flat white and a chocolate croissant," "chicken burrito bowl" - and BurnWeek estimates the calories and protein for you and adds it to your day. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.

Ask how your day is going and BurnWeek shows what you've eaten and how much you have left. BurnWeek also tracks a 7-day sliding-window budget, so one big day doesn't mean failure - you just balance it out over the week. Made a mistake? Say "undo that." Got the portion wrong? "Make the rice 200 grams" and the estimate recomputes. You can also save recipes and favorites, set up recurring meals, log from a photo or a barcode, and plan meals ahead.

BurnWeek logs to your own private account. Connect your existing BurnWeek app history with a one-time link code so your meals stay in sync between the app and ChatGPT. BurnWeek is general-wellness software, not medical advice, and it never collects payment, location, or health-record data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f362b92481919c078e43.longDescriptionZh:
BurnWeek 是一款人工智能卡路里追踪器，可满足您当前的需求。只需说出您吃了什么——“一杯白咖啡和一个巧克力羊角面包”、“鸡肉卷饼碗”——BurnWeek 就会为您估算卡路里和蛋白质，并将其添加到您的一天中。由于食物从来都不是精确的，BurnWeek 显示的是真实的范围（例如“680-780 卡路里”），而不是虚假的精确数字。

询问您今天过得怎么样，BurnWeek 会显示您吃了什么以及还剩下多少。 BurnWeek 还跟踪 7 天的滑动窗口预算，因此重要的一天并不意味着失败 - 您只需在一周内进行平衡即可。犯错了吗？说“撤消该操作”。是不是分错部分了？ “将米做成 200 克”，然后重新计算估算值。您还可以保存食谱和收藏夹、设置定期膳食、从照片或条形码记录以及提前计划膳食。

BurnWeek 登录到您自己的私人帐户。使用一次性链接代码连接您现有的 BurnWeek 应用程序历史记录，以便您的餐食在应用程序和 ChatGPT 之间保持同步。 BurnWeek 是一般健康软件，不是医疗建议，它从不收集付款、位置或健康记录数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a97be305050819192a4130e.longDescription: Joti is a workout tracking app for planning, scheduling, and logging strength, bodyweight, flexibility, and cardio training. This connector lets ChatGPT read a user's own workouts, completed workout history, aggregated stats (volume, consistency, personal bests, top lifts), and the shared exercise library (roughly 800 exercises plus the user's own custom ones), and to schedule workouts onto the user's calendar. Writes are additive only: create a brand-new workout, duplicate an existing one, and fully manage scheduled-workout calendar entries. It cannot edit or delete an existing workout's exercises/sets, and cannot start, log, or alter a session — those stay in the Joti app. Body measurements and progress photos are out of scope entirely. Reads are scoped to data the user owns outright; every write is undoable in Joti's Activity feed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a97be305050819192a4130e.longDescriptionZh:

Joti is a workout tracking app for planning, scheduling, and logging strength, bodyweight, flexibility, and cardio training. This connector lets ChatGPT read a user's own workouts, completed workout history, aggregated stats (volume, consistency, personal bests, top lifts), and the shared exercise library (roughly 800 exercises plus the user's own custom ones), and to schedule workouts onto the user's calendar. Writes are additive only: create a brand-new workout, duplicate an existing one, and fully manage scheduled-workout calendar entries. It cannot edit or delete an existing workout's exercises/sets, and cannot start, log, or alter a session — those stay in the Joti app. Body measurements and progress photos are out of scope entirely. Reads are scoped to data the user owns outright; every write is undoable in Joti's Activity feed.
